text:
sam: quick heads-up — QA reported the v1->v2 fallback toggle in Console isn't sticky for orgs that have route overrides. repro: flip the toggle, refresh, toggle resets.

arjun: hmm. is that the feature flag UI or the per-route override?

sam: per-route. we store org-level setting but route-level config rehydrates from cached policy and overrides the UI state.

mia: ouch. that explains a few support tickets. UI shows the org-level checkbox but the backend applies route-level rules. users are confused.

kate: impact? are requests actually hitting unexpected model variants? any quota/latency fallout?

sam: support reported a customer with mixed traffic — some requests still served by v1 fallback => slightly higher token cost. not huge but enough for them to notice.

arjun: quick root cause: console reads /orgs/:id/features -> {compat_fallback:true} but the routing service prefers /orgs/:id/routes which has explicit field compat_override:false. when console merges on the client it naively prefers routes. backend merge should be authoritative.

mia: propose: console should display merged effective policy (server-calculated) not naive client merge. Also add a small inline note: "Effective policy: route-level overrides in effect".

kate: agree. plus we need a telemetry flag to count how often UI and effective policy diverge. want numbers before we roll a fix.

arjun: i'll add a tiny probe in routing service that emits tags: {org, route_id, ui_flag, effective_flag}. that's low-cost.

sam: can we sample first? don't want to spike metrics.

arjun: yes, sample 1% by default; make config param in /infra/telemetry/sample_rates.

mia: UI change: show both "configured" and "effective" values with tooltip. minimal copy: "Configured fallback (org): true — Effective: false (route-level override)". also add link to route list.

kate: rollout plan: patch routing probe and sample for 24h, then dashboard of divergence rate. if divergence > 0.5% for top 100 orgs, ship console UI fix. target: patch + canary deploy on prod routing 02:00 UTC tomorrow.

sam: also add a support banner for affected orgs: "If you rely on org-level fallback, ensure route-level overrides are set" — ephemeral.

arjun: config snippet I'll push to PR:
```json
{
  "compat_probe": {
    "enabled": true,
    "sample_rate": 0.01
  }
}
```

mia: small UX nit — don't show checkbox until server returns effective policy. show spinner instead of wrong state.

kate: agreed. ownership: arjun for probe+instrumentation, mia for console change, sam for support doc + banner. timeline: probe by EOD, UI PR by tomorrow, canary after approvals.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-service/probe v1.3 -> canary @ 02:00 UTC 2481237900 (:rocket:)
